clusters.title: Nvidia Surge and Market Rally
clusters.summary: Global stock markets surged, with major indexes posting massive gains following the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia. The dramatic leadership return triggered a historic market rally and sparked widespread media coverage of tech sector valuations.

clusters.title: GTA 6 Launch and Tech Releases
clusters.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI dominated gaming headlines with guides, reviews, and post-launch updates alongside reports of technical glitches and leaks. Meanwhile, major tech firms revealed new hardware, AI integration tools, and early Black Friday deals.

clusters.title: Health, Science, and Medical Discoveries
clusters.summary: Recent studies highlighted various health risks, ranging from diet and diabetes links to Alzheimer's research and supplement efficacy. Concurrently, astronomers and researchers reported groundbreaking discoveries in space, including rare star systems and ancient fossils.

global_summary: Today's news is dominated by a historic stock market surge driven by Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia and major tech industry developments. In entertainment and gaming, the massive launch of Grand Theft Auto VI captured global attention alongside various Hollywood casting and renewal announcements. Meanwhile, researchers released significant updates spanning medical breakthroughs, health warnings, and astronomical discoveries.
